leads.name: PQAI (Patent Quality AI) search server
leads.class: PRIOR-ART SEARCH IMPLEMENTATION (MIT). The directions ask: compare against the existing Google Patents/Lens retrieval stack.
leads.existing_stack: discovery_fabric/source_registry/connectors/patents.py — GooglePatentsConnector + LensConnector, both over the prior_art_v2 wrapper (the _PaV2Wrapper bridge, collision_resolution state machine). The stack is LIVE in the production per-candidate collision path (run.py::_collision_for_candidate).
leads.comparison: PQAI bundles its own patent index + semantic search server (a deployment dependency: embeddings, a patent corpus, an API service). The existing stack is zero-deployment HTTP connectors. Integrating PQAI = standing up and maintaining a search service for a marginal recall delta that has NOT been measured. The honest comparison needs a measurable-benefit arm: same candidates, PQAI vs Google+Lens collision results, delta in prior-art collisions found — which is a quota-consuming measurement, not a code drop.
leads.integration_point: IF adopted: a third ConnectorBase subclass beside GooglePatents/Lens in connectors/patents.py behind the same _PaV2Wrapper — but ONLY after the measured-benefit arm justifies it.
leads.measurable_benefit: NOT YET MEASURED (the comparison run is the prerequisite; deferred to its own claim).
leads.action: typed DEFERRED-WITH-PREREQUISITE: no integration without the measured recall delta.

leads.name: Microsoft MatterGen

verified.source: GitHub API, read this window; the Nature paper s41586-025-08628-5

leads.class: GENERATIVE INORGANIC MATERIALS DESIGN (diffusion over crystal structures — composition + property-conditioned novel materials).
leads.assessment: the directions' own framing is exact: materials-SPECIFIC invention, not generic mechanism generation. The engine's mechanism space is CAUSAL-MECHANISM-level (device -> failure -> intervention physics); MatterGen generates CRYSTAL STRUCTURES (unit cells, lattice parameters). The only honest integration is a MATERIALS-DOMAIN plugin: when a fresh problem's domain is materials-synthesis AND the intervention needs a candidate composition, MatterGen could enumerate candidate structures for the engineering-evaluation stage. That is a new domain module (domains.py pattern), heavy (model weights + inference), and zero of the current five R137-fresh domains are composition-discovery problems.
leads.integration_point: NONE THIS WINDOW — no current problem class exercises it; adopting it now would be popularity-driven (the exact failure mode the directions forbid).
leads.measurable_benefit: NOT MEASURABLE on the current problem distribution (typed honestly).
leads.action: typed REVISIT-WHEN-A-MATERIALS-PROBLEM-CLASS-EXISTS: the honest trigger is a fresh problem set where >=3 problems need composition-space search.
